articles.title: The midterms could fuel the K-shaped AI trade
articles.description: U.S. midterm results could slow data center development, raising the value of existing AI capacity while increasing pressure on debt-funded neoclouds.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin hack continued hours after exchange said attack was contained, report finds
articles.description: The same attacker took about $391,000, mostly from wallets Bitquery ties to BitMart, whose founder confirmed a Nov. 2 hack and suspects a link.

articles.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
articles.description: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on "whether the Razorbacks win or lose" is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

articles.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
articles.description: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

articles.title: OpenAI pledges to pay for data center power after election highlights AI concerns
articles.description: OpenAI pledged to solicit community input around AI data centers, publish construction plans and protect ratepayers.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
articles.description: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.

articles.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
articles.description: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

articles.title: Rheinmetall shares plunge 17% after outlook cut as military contracts stall
articles.description: Rheinmetall cut its 2026 outlook for the second time in three months, citing delays to German military projects and artillery ammunition deliveries.

articles.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
articles.description: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

articles.title: Hong Kong passes law requiring crypto exchanges to report customer transactions to tax authorities
articles.description: Crypto firms must collect customer and transaction data from 2027, with Hong Kong sharing the information with overseas tax authorities from 2028.

articles.title: OpenAI says its AI can break into Linux at scale. Here's what it means for crypto
articles.description: OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux flaws and wrote a working attack for each one. Crypto security voices say decentralization leaves the industry better placed than most to cope.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
articles.description: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

articles.title: From tanks to drones: South Korea’s defense firms face a new battlefield test
articles.description: South Korean defense stocks rode a wave of global rearmament for the past two years, but they have plunged in 2026.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite
articles.description: Sales of Nintendo's flagship Switch 2 plunged in its fiscal second quarter after the Japanese gaming giant rolled out price hikes amid soaring memory costs.

articles.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
articles.description: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.

articles.title: NextDC shares soar nearly 51% after Goodman, Digital Realty stake purchases
articles.description: NextDC shares surged nearly 51% Thursday morning after Goodman Group and Digital Realty sought to acquire up to a 9.9% stake.

articles.title: What the Democratic midterms sweep changes for U.S.-China relations
articles.description: Analysts note the growing risks around U.S. President Donald Trump's ability to maintain a fragile trade truce.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
articles.description: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

articles.title: Russia, China may be more aggressive if they feel Trump is on 'his way out': Brookings
articles.description: Russia and China may be more aggressive if they feel that U.S. President Donald Trump is on "his way out" after the Democratic Party flipped the midterms.
